description: Adjust stock quantity for a product at a specific warehouse — add, remove, or set to an absolute value.

product_id.description: ID of the product to adjust

warehouse_id.description: ID of the warehouse where the adjustment takes place

adjustment_type.description: Type of adjustment: add, remove, or set

quantity.description: Quantity to add, remove, or set

reason.description: Reason for the adjustment: restock, sale, damage, audit, or transfer

performed_by.description: User ID of the operator performing the adjustment

unit_cost.description: Optional cost per unit for this adjustment, used for inventory valuation

batch_id.description: Optional batch identifier for lot tracking

expiry_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the expiry of this batch

notes.description: Optional free-text notes about the adjustment

notify.description: Optional configuration for low-stock notifications triggered by this adjustment

on_low_stock.description: If true, send a notification when stock falls below the threshold

threshold.description: Stock level at or below which a low-stock notification is sent

tags.description: Optional list of tags for categorising or searching adjustments
